svg.title: Aditya K Koundinya. Computational cognitive science: memory, attention and decision. CSE graduate. I study the mind as an information processing system, and I want to build and test formal models of how it works. The animation shows noisy evidence drifting from a starting point until it reaches one of two decision bounds.

div.div: Evidence accumulates, noisily, until it hits a bound.
